bibl.title: Mallokouria: Portraits of Local Elite Boys in Roman Egypt.

Susan E. Alcock, Mariana Egri & James F.D. Frakes (edd.), Beyond Boundaries. Connecting Visual Cultures in the Provinces of Ancient Rome (Los Angeles, 2016) pp. 156-173, figg.
bibl.note: The youth-lock in ancient, Ptolemaic, and Roman Egypt. - Mallokouretai on mummy portraits and Lucian's "Egyptian" boy. - Greek forerunners of the mallokouretai hairstyle? - Portraits of mallokouretai in the round. - Conclusion.
